text: dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 是面向 DSH Web 配置的模型提供方插件：插件加载时由 host 启动本机网关，网关通过 OpenAI 兼容接口把请求交给已登录的 DeepSeek 网页版。它提供快速、专家和识图模型选项，可将网页回复中的 tool_call 格式转换为 DSH 可执行的工具调用，并支持连续对话、长会话摘要迁移、模型校准和并发子 agent 页面。用户需配置 DSH provider 并登录自己的 DeepSeek 账号；插件本身不要求真实 API Key。

Adds DeepSeek Web to DSH through an OpenAI-compatible gateway and a signed-in browser. It offers quick, expert, and vision models, converts tool_call replies to DSH calls, and supports chat migration, calibration, and parallel agent pages. Configure a provider and sign in; no API key is needed.

如何让多个子 agent 同时通过网页模型处理请求？

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「自动启动本地网关」：DSH 加载插件时 host 拉起网关，卸载时结束由它启动的进程；网关监听本机端口并提供 OpenAI 兼容模型接口。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「登录 DeepSeek 网页版」：用户打开本机 /login 页面后，在启动的浏览器窗口登录 DeepSeek；驱动轮询登录状态，供后续模型请求复用。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「选择模型模式」：模型列表包含快速、专家和识图选项；网关将请求路由为 quick、expert 或 vision 模式，并可应用记录的模型选择校准。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「把网页回复转成工具调用」：请求带有工具定义时，网关提示模型输出 tool_call；驱动解析工具名和参数并以 OpenAI tool_calls 形式返回给 DSH。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「延续并迁移长对话」：驱动保留网页会话历史；达到轮数限制时提取最近对话摘要，开启新会话并注入摘要继续处理。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「并发处理 agent 请求」：主请求使用常驻页面；已有请求运行时，新请求分配独立页面，结束后将页面放回池中复用。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 的功能「校准模型选择」：校准接口打开浏览器窗口记录用户点击，支持收集和保存点击序列；推理时回放序列来切换会话模型。
dsh-deepseek-web-adapter 使用本机 Chrome 或 Edge 驱动网页会话；找不到浏览器时需要安装浏览器或设置 DS_WEB_CHROME 路径。

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · 已知限制：| 限制 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 开发中（Beta） | 未经大规模真实环境验证，可能有不稳定行为 |
| 无 client 卡片 UI | 本包只有 host（自动拉起网关）。**没有登录按钮/校准/无头开关等卡片控件**——登录请手动打开 `http://127.0.0.1:5688/login`，配置用 `curl` 调 `/config`（见手动控制）。卡片 UI 在开发仓库（`dsweb-plugin/client-llm.js`），欢迎贡献 |
| 依赖真实浏览器 | 需要本机安装 Chrome；登录态是内存 cookie，关闭窗口需重新登录 |
| 依赖 DeepSeek 网页版 UI | 网页版改版可能导致选择器失效（校准/发送/提取），届时需更新 `driver.js` |
| 解析器有兜底但非万能 | 54 场景回归覆盖常见格式；模型输出极端怪异格式时工具调用仍可能失败 |

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deepseek-web-adapter

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · 或从 GitHub（发布后）：：dsh plugin --profile web add github:你的用户名/dsh-deepseek-web-adapter

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · 配置 DSH 模型提供方：编辑 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`，在 `llm-pi-ai.providers: { ... }` 内加入：

```yaml
dsweb:
  {
    displayName: DeepSeek 网页版 (免 API),
    apiKeyEnv: MOCK_LLM_KEY,

并在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 加：`MOCK_LLM_KEY: sk-mock-any-value`（任意值，网关不校验）。
DSH 配置热加载——模型选择器立即出现 DeepSeek 网页版。

> Verified: login, basic Q&A, Expert-mode switch, single tool call, gateway auto-start/stop.

> Please report issues at [Issues](https://github.com/huermi/dsh-deepseek-web-adapter/issues).

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · dsh-deepseek-web-adapter：Turn **DeepSeek Web (chat.deepseek.com)** into a free, API-key-free LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
On plugin load, a local gateway (`resources/dsweb-gateway.js` + `driver.js`, one persistent browser) is
spawned automatically and serves an OpenAI-compatible API. Supports: continuous chat, tool calling,
model calibration, and concurrent sub-agents.

- No API key, no third-party login (just your own DeepSeek account)
- `dsh plugin add` — one command; the gateway auto-starts/stops

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Known limitations：| Limitation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Beta quality | Not extensively tested in real environments; behavior may be unstable |
| No client card UI | This package ships host only (auto-launch gateway). **No login/calibration/headless card controls** — open `http://127.0.0.1:5688/login` manually to log in, configure via `curl` to `/config` (see Manual control). Card UI lives in the dev repo (`dsweb-plugin/client-llm.js`); contributions welcome |
| Requires a real browser | Needs Chrome installed locally; login session is an in-memory cookie — closing the window requires re-login |
| Depends on DeepSeek web UI | UI changes may break selectors (calibration/send/extract); `driver.js` then needs updating |
| Parser is tolerant, not infallible | 54-case regression covers common formats; exotic malformed model output may still fail |

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deepseek-web-adapter

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · or from GitHub (after publishing):：dsh plugin --profile web add github:your-name/dsh-deepseek-web-adapter
```

On load, the gateway starts automatically (3–8s; see the DSH terminal log:
`DeepSeek 网页版网关已监听 5688`).

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Configure the DSH provider：Edit `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, inside `llm-pi-ai.providers: { ... }` add:

```yaml
dsweb:
  {
    displayName: DeepSeek Web (no API key),
    apiKeyEnv: MOCK_LLM_KEY,

Add `MOCK_LLM_KEY: sk-mock-any-value` to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (any value; the gateway does not check it).
DSH config hot-reloads — the DeepSeek Web models appear in the model picker immediately.

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Login：Open `http://127.0.0.1:5688/login` in a browser and sign in to chat.deepseek.com.
If a "Keep me signed in / Remember me" option exists, tick it — the session persists across restarts.

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Usage：| Capability | Notes |
|---|---|
| Continuous chat | Web page keeps history; auto-migrates (summary + new session) beyond the length limit (default 50 turns, configurable) |
| Tool calling | Model emits a `tool_call` code block → gateway parses it (54-case hardened parser) → DSH executes |
| Model calibration | `deepseek-reasoner` → Expert mode (calibration data bundled; can be re-recorded) |
| Sub-agent concurrency | Concurrent requests use separate pages (parallel windows) |

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · Check gateway status：curl http://127.0.0.1:5688/v1/models

```

DSH (dsweb provider) → gateway :5688 → driver (persistent Chrome) → chat.deepseek.com
plugin load → spawn gateway → unload → recycle
```

dsh-deepseek-web-adapter README · How it works：DeepSeek Web has no native function calling — the gateway uses prompt engineering to make the model emit
`tool_call` JSON, then converts it to standard `tool_calls` via a multi-layer tolerant parser
(nested JSON, parameter aliases, single-backslash Windows paths, trailing commas, unquoted keys,
retry safety net) for DSH to execute. Tool results feed back into the web page and the model continues.
Regression suite: 54 scenarios (see `tests/` in the dev repo).
